newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman shares end lower for second week running.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares end lower for second week running.

text.p: Weaker buying interest dragged shares on Oman's stock exchange lower for the second week running, with the index falling nearly 1.5 percent, the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said.
The index closed 2.77 points lower in the week to Wednesday at 182.22 from 184.99 points.
Of the 49 companies traded in the week, shares of 34 fell, seven rose, and eight were unchanged, the MSM said.
National Bank of Oman closed at 2.990 rials from 3.000 last week, Al-Ahlia Portfolio ended at 2.950 from 3.080 rials and Oman Flour Mills at 3.700 rials from 3.750.
Bank shares accounted for 51 percent of total trading value of 2.54 million rials ($6.7 million) from 4.81 million rials ($12.6 million) the previous week.
